throughput_note: Trainer reports the configured 3760 examples and 118 steps divided by the early-stopped runtime. Actual work was 20 steps × 32 examples = 640 presentations. Runtime includes training startup; it excludes matched evaluation and export.
telemetry_note: Samples polled every 2 seconds. Phase and last-completed-step labels approximate boundaries. Setup, saving, and the step 20 boundary are excluded. Step 0 includes warmup or compilation; the warm subset begins at step 5. VRAM percentage is not compute utilization. Host RAM was not measured here.
